blocks.text: Yeh chapter 4 (Molecular Biology (chapter banner printed as 'Biomolecules')) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The study of the chemical components and chemical processes occurring in living organisms is called:
(Jaandaaron mein paye jane wale chemical ajza aur chemical amal ke mutaale ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Biochemistry jaandaaron mein chemical ajza aur chemical amal ka mutaala hai.

book_ref.quote: Biochemistry is the study of chemical components and chemical processes

blocks.prompt:
2 All the chemical reactions taking place within a cell are collectively called:
(Cell ke andar hone wale tamam chemical reactions ko mil kar kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cell ke tamam chemical reactions mil kar metabolism (ghiza-kari amal) kehlate hain; is mein anabolism aur catabolism dono shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: All the chemical reactions taking place within a cell are collectively called metabolism

blocks.prompt:
3 In which process are simpler substances combined to form complex substances?
(Kis amal mein saada substances jor kar pecheeda substances banaye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Anabolism mein saada substances jur kar pecheeda bante hain; catabolism mein pecheeda molecules toot kar saada bante hain.

book_ref.quote: In anabolism, simpler substances are combined to form complex substances

blocks.prompt:
4 Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids and nucleic acids together make what percentage of the dry mass of living organisms?
(Carbohydrates, proteins, lipids aur nucleic acids mil kar jaandaaron ke dry mass (khushk wazan) ka kitna feesad banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh chaar organic molecules dry mass ka 93% banate hain; baqi 7% chhote organic aur inorganic molecules hain.

book_ref.quote: They make 93% of the dry mass of living organisms

blocks.prompt:
5 Which of the following is given in the book as an example of a small organic molecule of protoplasm?
(Kitaab mein protoplasm ke chhote organic molecule ki misaal kaun si di gayi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Baqi 7% mein chhote organic molecules (jaise vitamins) aur inorganic molecules (CO₂, acids, bases, salts) hain.

book_ref.quote: The remaining 7% comprises of small organic molecules (like vitamins)

blocks.prompt:
6 According to Table 4.1, which group makes the largest share (50%) of the dry mass of protoplasm?
(Table 4.1 ke mutabiq protoplasm ke dry mass ka sab se bara hissa (50%) kaun sa group banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 4.1: proteins 50%, nucleic acids 18%, carbohydrates 15%, lipids 10%.

book_ref.quote: Table 4.1: %age of major organic molecules in the dry mass of protoplasm

blocks.prompt:
7 Nucleic acids make what percentage of the dry mass of protoplasm (Table 4.1)?
(Nucleic acids protoplasm ke dry mass ka kitna feesad hain (Table 4.1)?)
blocks.explanation: Table 4.1 ke mutabiq nucleic acids dry mass ka 18% hain (carbohydrates 15%, lipids 10%, proteins 50%).

book_ref.quote: Table 4.1: %age of major organic molecules in the dry mass of protoplasm

blocks.prompt:
8 Most biochemical reactions involve:
(Zyada tar biochemical reactions mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: functional group ka aik molecule se doosre mein jana, ya carbon-carbon bond ka tootna
sirf paani ke molecules ka tootna

blocks.explanation: Organic molecules ka carbon core hota hai jis se functional groups (OH, CO, COOH, NH₂) jure hote hain; zyada tar reactions mein functional group aik molecule se doosre mein jata hai ya carbon-carbon bond toot-ta hai.

book_ref.quote: Most biochemical reactions involve the transfer of a functional group from one molecule to another

blocks.prompt:
9 Nucleic acids are polymers of which monomers?
(Nucleic acids kin monomers ke polymers hain?)
blocks.explanation: Carbohydrates, proteins aur nucleic acids tarteeb se sugars, amino acids aur nucleotides ke polymers hain.

book_ref.quote: Important macromolecules like carbohydrates, proteins, and nucleic acids are the polymers of simple monomers

blocks.prompt:
10 A molecule consisting of many identical molecular units is called a:
(Woh molecule jo bohat se aik jaise molecular units se bana ho, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Polymer bohat se aik jaise units (monomers) se bana molecule hai.

book_ref.quote: A polymer is a molecule consisting of many identical molecular units, called monomers

blocks.prompt:
11 Which bond is the potential source of chemical energy for cellular activities?
(Cell ki sargarmiyon ke liye chemical energy ka mumkina zariya kaun sa bond hai?)
blocks.explanation: Carbon-hydrogen (C-H) bond cell ki sargarmiyon ke liye chemical energy ka mumkina zariya hai (4.2).

book_ref.quote: Carbon and hydrogen bond (C-H bond) is the potential source of chemical energy

blocks.prompt:
12 Stability to complex carbohydrate molecules is provided by carbon-oxygen association in:
(Pecheeda carbohydrate molecules ko mazbooti kis mein carbon-oxygen jor deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glycosidic linkages mein carbon-oxygen jor pecheeda carbohydrates ko mazboot banata hai; carbon-nitrogen jor peptide bond banata hai (4.2).

book_ref.quote: Carbon-oxygen association in glycosidic linkages provides stability

blocks.prompt:
13 A bond formed when two atoms share electrons is a/an:
(Jab do atoms electrons share karein to kaun sa bond banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Covalent bond electrons ki sharing se banta hai; yeh proteins aur nucleic acids ko mazbooti deta hai (4.2).

book_ref.quote: Covalent bonds form when two atoms share electrons

blocks.prompt:
14 In ionic bonding, the atom that accepts an electron becomes a/an:
(Ionic bond mein electron qubool karne wala atom kya ban jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Electron dene wala atom cation aur electron lene wala atom negative ion yani anion ban jata hai (4.2).

book_ref.quote: another atom accepts the electron (becomes a negative ion, or anion)

blocks.prompt:
15 Ionic bonds are relatively strong in the solid state and are formed mostly in:
(Ionic bonds solid haalat mein nisbatan mazboot hote hain aur zyada tar kahan bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ionic bonds zyada tar inorganic molecules mein bante hain, jaise sodium chloride (4.2).

book_ref.quote: formed mostly in inorganic molecules like sodium chloride

blocks.prompt:
16 Hydrogen bonds are weak attractions between a hydrogen atom and:
(Hydrogen bond hydrogen atom aur kis ke darmiyan kamzor kashish hai?)

options.text: electronegative atom, jaise oxygen ya nitrogen

blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bond hydrogen atom aur electronegative atom (O ya N) ke darmiyan kamzor kashish hai; yeh proteins aur nucleic acids ki banawat qaim rakhta hai (4.2).

book_ref.quote: Hydrogen bonds are weak attractions that occur between a hydrogen atom and an electronegative atom

blocks.prompt:
17 Clustering of nonpolar molecules in water is crucial for:
(Paani mein nonpolar molecules ka ikattha hona kis ke liye bohat zaroori hai?)

options.text: proteins ki folding aur lipid bilayers ka banna

blocks.explanation: Hydrophobic interactions (nonpolar molecules ka paani se bachne ke liye ikattha hona) protein folding aur membranes ki lipid bilayer ke liye zaroori hain (4.2).

book_ref.quote: This phenomenon is crucial for the folding of proteins and the formation of lipid bilayers

blocks.prompt:
18 Interactions between polar molecules and water molecules are called:
(Polar molecules aur paani ke molecules ke darmiyan interactions kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrophilic interactions polar molecules aur paani ke darmiyan hoti hain aur polar aur ionic compounds ko hal karne ke liye zaroori hain (4.2).

book_ref.quote: These interactions are essential for the dissolution of polar and ionic compounds in water

blocks.prompt:
19 During condensation of two monomers:
(Do monomers ki condensation ke dauran kya hota hai?)

options.text: dono monomers mein -H jur jata hai
aik monomer mein -OH jur jata hai
aik monomer se -OH aur doosre se -H hat jata hai
dono se phosphate hat jata hai

blocks.explanation: Condensation mein aik monomer se -OH aur doosre se -H hat-ta hai, yani paani ka aik molecule nikalta hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: During condensation, an -OH group is removed from one monomer and an -H atom is removed from another monomer

blocks.prompt:
20 Which of the following is the book's example of a condensation reaction?
(Kitaab mein condensation reaction ki misaal kaun si hai?)

options.text: do glucose monomers se maltose banna
maltose ka do glucose mein tootna
patte se paani ka bukhaarat banna

blocks.explanation: Do glucose se maltose banna condensation hai; maltose ka do glucose mein tootna hydrolysis hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: The formation of maltose by two glucose monomers is an example of a condensation reaction

blocks.prompt:
21 Why must cells supply energy to make macromolecules?
(Cells ko macromolecules banane ke liye energy kyun deni parti hai?)

options.text: monomers mein paani jorna parta hai
macromolecules bante waqt heat kharij karte hain
monomers se paani nikalte waqt chemical bonds torne ke liye energy chahiye

blocks.explanation: Monomers se paani nikalte waqt chemical bonds torne ke liye energy chahiye, is liye cells ko macromolecules banane ke liye energy deni parti hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: So, cells must supply energy to make macromolecules

blocks.prompt:
22 In hydrolysis, the parts of the added water molecule go as follows:
(Hydrolysis mein shamil kiye gaye paani ke molecule ke hisse kahan jate hain?)

options.text: OH aik monomer se aur H doosre monomer se jurta hai
OH aur H dono aik hi monomer se jurte hain
OH gas ki shakal mein nikalta hai
H dono monomers se jurta hai

blocks.explanation: Hydrolysis dehydration synthesis ka ulat hai: paani ka OH aik monomer se aur H doosre monomer se jurta hai (4.3).

book_ref.quote: OH group from a water molecule joins to one monomer and hydrogen joins to the second monomer

blocks.prompt:
23 Breakdown of macromolecules by hydrolysis is essential in:
(Hydrolysis se macromolecules ka tootna kis amal mein zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Macromolecules ki hydrolysis digestion (hazma) aur cellular respiration mein zaroori hai jahan energy ke liye chhote molecules chahiye (4.3).

book_ref.quote: such as digestion and cellular respiration

blocks.prompt:
24 The concentration of water in different organisms varies from:
(Mukhtalif jaandaaron mein paani ki miqdaar kitne feesad ke darmiyan hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani tamam jaandaaron mein sab se zyada paya jane wala compound hai; is ki miqdaar 65 se 89 feesad tak hoti hai (4.4).

book_ref.quote: Its concentration varies from 65 to 89 percent in different organisms

blocks.prompt:
25 Brain cells contain about what percentage of water?
(Dimagh ke cells mein taqreeban kitna feesad paani hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Haddi ke cells mein taqreeban 20 feesad aur dimagh ke cells mein 85 feesad paani hota hai (4.4).

book_ref.quote: bone cells are made up of about 20 percent water and brain cells contain 85 percent water

blocks.prompt:
26 In a water molecule:
(Paani ke molecule mein:)

options.text: hydrogen juzvi negative aur oxygen juzvi positive hai
dono atoms par poora charge hai
hydrogen juzvi positive aur oxygen juzvi negative hai
dono atoms par koi charge nahi

blocks.explanation: Paani polar hai: hydrogen juzvi (partially) positive aur oxygen juzvi negative hai.

book_ref.quote: Hydrogen atom is partially positive and oxygen atom is partially negative

blocks.prompt:
27 Without hydrogen bonding, water would boil at:
(Hydrogen bonding ke baghair paani kis temperature par ubalta?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bonding ke baghair paani –80 °C par ubalta aur –100 °C par jam jata, aur zindagi na-mumkin hoti.

book_ref.quote: Without hydrogen bonding water would boil at – 80 °C

blocks.prompt:
28 Molecules such as salts, sugars and amino acids, which dissolve readily in water, are called:
(Salts, sugars aur amino acids jaise molecules jo paani mein asaani se hal hote hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Charged ya polar molecules (salts, sugars, amino acids) asaani se hal hote hain aur hydrophilic (paani pasand) kehlate hain; lipids hydrophobic hain.

book_ref.quote: Charged or polar molecules such as salts, sugars, amino acids dissolve readily in water

blocks.prompt:
29 When sodium chloride is placed in water, its Na⁺ and Cl⁻ ions are:
(Jab sodium chloride paani mein dala jaye to is ke Na⁺ aur Cl⁻ ions ke saath kya hota hai?)

options.text: paani ke molecules ke mukhalif polar siron mein ghir jate hain
paani se covalent bond bana lete hain
paani se bahar nikal diye jate hain

blocks.explanation: NaCl Na⁺ aur Cl⁻ mein toot jata hai; in ions ko paani ke molecules ke mukhalif polar sire gher lete hain (Figure 4.7).

book_ref.quote: These ions are surrounded by opposite polar ends of water molecules

blocks.prompt:
30 Glucose dissolves in water because water molecules form hydrogen bonds with glucose's:
(Glucose paani mein is liye hal hota hai ke paani ke molecules glucose ke kin groups se hydrogen bond banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Paani glucose ke polar hydroxyl groups se hydrogen bonds banata hai, is liye glucose hal ho jata hai (Figure 4.8).

book_ref.quote: the molecules of water form hydrogen bonds with polar hydroxyl groups of glucose molecules

blocks.prompt:
31 Hydrogen bonds help in maintaining the three-dimensional structure of proteins and:
(Hydrogen bonds proteins ki teen-jehti (3D) banawat ke ilawa kis ki banawat qaim rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bonds proteins ki 3D banawat aur DNA ke double helix ko qaim rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Hydrogen bonds help in maintaining the three-dimensional structures of proteins

blocks.prompt:
32 The attraction between the same type of molecules, as among water molecules, is called:
(Aik hi qisam ke molecules ke darmiyan kashish, jaise paani ke molecules mein, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bonds paani ke molecules ko aapas mein jore rakhte hain; aik hi qisam ke molecules ki yeh kashish cohesion (chipkao) hai.

book_ref.quote: This type of attraction between same type of molecules is called cohesion

blocks.prompt:
33 Water rises in plants against gravity because evaporation from leaves pulls water in xylem and the pull is relayed down to the roots by:
(Paudon mein paani kashish-e-saql ke khilaf is liye charhta hai ke patton se bukhaarat xylem ke paani ko kheenchti hai aur yeh khinchao jaron tak kis wajah se pohanchta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Patte se bukhaarat xylem ke paani ko kheenchti hai; cohesion ki wajah se yeh qowat jaron tak pohanchti hai aur paani upar charhta hai.

book_ref.quote: The evaporation of water from a leaf exerts a pulling force on water within xylem vessels

blocks.prompt:
34 The insect water-strider walks on water without breaking its surface because water has:
(Keera water-strider paani ki satah toray baghair is par is liye chal sakta hai ke paani mein:)
blocks.explanation: Hydrogen bonds paani ko zyada surface tension (satahi tanao) dete hain; paani aisa lagta hai jaise is par na-nazar aane wali jhilli ho.

book_ref.quote: Hydrogen bonds also give water high surface tension

blocks.prompt:
35 Specific heat capacity is the amount of heat required to raise the temperature of 1 gram of a substance:
(Specific heat capacity woh heat hai jo 1 gram substance ka temperature kitna barhane ke liye chahiye?)

options.text: jab tak woh ubal na jaye

blocks.explanation: Specific heat capacity: woh calories jo 1 gram substance ka temperature 15 °C se 16 °C, yani 1 °C barhane ke liye chahiye.

book_ref.quote: required to raise the temperature of 1 gram of a substance from 15°C to 16°C

blocks.prompt:
36 The specific heat capacity of water given in the book is:
(Kitaab mein paani ki specific heat capacity kitni di gayi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani ki specific heat capacity zyada hai, 4.184 Joules, is liye yeh apna temperature kam badle heat jazb aur kharij karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Water has a high specific heat capacity i.e., 4.184 Joules

blocks.prompt:
37 Most of the heat energy absorbed by water is used to:
(Paani ki jazb ki hui zyada tar heat energy kis kaam aati hai?)

options.text: molecule ke andar covalent bonds torna
paani ke molecules ko ionize karna
molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds torna

blocks.explanation: Jazb hui zyada tar heat paani ke molecules ke darmiyan hydrogen bonds torti hai; phir molecules azadi se harkat karte hain aur temperature barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Most of the heat energy absorbed by water is used to break hydrogen bonds between its molecules

blocks.prompt:
38 The specific heat of water is nine times more than that of:
(Paani ki specific heat kis cheez se nau guna zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani ki specific heat zyada tar carbon compounds se do guna aur iron (loha) se nau guna zyada hai.

book_ref.quote: is nine times more than that of iron

blocks.prompt:
39 The heat of vaporization of water is:
(Paani ki heat of vaporization kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani ki heat of vaporization 574 Kcal/kg hai: 1 kg maae (liquid) paani ko bukhaarat banane ke liye 574 Kcal chahiye.

book_ref.quote: Its heat of vaporization is 574 Kcal/kg

blocks.prompt:
40 Evaporation of 2 ml of water out of 1 litre lowers the temperature of the remaining 998 ml by:
(1 litre mein se 2 ml paani ke bukhaarat banne se baqi 998 ml ka temperature kitna girta hai?)
blocks.explanation: 1 litre mein se 2 ml paani bukhaarat bane to baqi 998 ml ka temperature 1 °C gir jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Evaporation of 2ml of water out of 1 litre lowers the temperature

blocks.prompt:
41 How does high heat of vaporization of water help plants and animals?
(Paani ki zyada heat of vaporization paudon aur janwaron ki kaise madad karti hai?)

options.text: transpiration aur paseene ke waqt thandak deti hai

blocks.explanation: Transpiration aur paseene ke waqt paani thandak deta hai: har gram bukhaarat banne par jism se 574 calories heat nikal jati hai.

book_ref.quote: removes 574 calories of heat from the body

blocks.prompt:
42 Non-polar molecules are insoluble in water because:
(Non-polar molecules paani mein hal kyun nahi hote?)

options.text: paani un se hydrogen bonds nahi banata
woh paani se reaction karte hain

blocks.explanation: Non-polar molecules is liye hal nahi hote ke paani un se hydrogen bonds nahi banata; paani unhein bahar dhakel deta hai.

book_ref.quote: because water molecules do not make hydrogen bonds with them

blocks.prompt:
43 Lipids help to maintain the membranes of cells because, when excluded from water, they:
(Lipids cell membranes ko qaim rakhne mein madad dete hain kyun ke paani se alag hone par woh:)

options.text: aapas mein mazboot jor banate hain
poori tarah hal ho jate hain
H⁺ aur OH⁻ mein ionize hote hain
paani se glycosidic bond banate hain

blocks.explanation: Lipids hal nahi hote; paani se alag ho kar aapas mein mazboot jor banate hain aur membranes ko qaim rakhte hain.

book_ref.quote: Therefore, lipids help to maintain membranes of cells

blocks.prompt:
44 At 25 °C, in a litre of water, how many molecules are ionized?
(25 °C par aik litre paani mein kitne molecules ionize hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kamre ke temperature (25 °C) par har 550 million mein se aik molecule ionize hota hai, is liye H⁺ aur OH⁻ dono 10⁻⁷ moles/litre hain.

book_ref.quote: one molecule out of each 550 million is ionized

blocks.prompt:
45 The concentration of each of H⁺ and OH⁻ ions in pure water is:
(Khalis paani mein H⁺ aur OH⁻ dono ki concentration kitni hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Khalis paani mein H⁺ aur OH⁻ dono ki concentration 10⁻⁷ moles/litre rehti hai.

book_ref.quote: concentration of each of H⁺ and OH⁻ in pure water remains at 10⁻⁷ moles/litre

blocks.prompt:
46 A medium becomes acidic when acids:
(Acids medium ko kaise acidic banate hain?)

options.text: OH⁻ ions se jur kar medium mein H⁺ chhor dete hain
H⁺ se jur kar OH⁻ chhor dete hain

blocks.explanation: Acids OH⁻ se jur kar H⁺ chhor dete hain (acidic medium); bases H⁺ se jur kar OH⁻ chhor dete hain (basic medium).

book_ref.quote: Acids combine with OH⁻ ions, leaving H⁺ ions in medium

blocks.prompt:
47 Water has its maximum density at:
(Paani ki density sab se zyada kis temperature par hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Paani ki density 4 °C par sab se zyada hai; is se neeche density kam hoti hai aur 0 °C ki barf maae paani se halki hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Water exhibits its maximum density at 4°C

blocks.prompt:
48 Ice floating on a lake protects aquatic organisms because it:
(Jheel par tairti barf aabi jaandaaron ko kaise bachati hai?)

options.text: ghiza ke ajza hal karti hai
insulator ban kar neeche ke paani se heat nikalne nahi deti

blocks.explanation: Barf halki hai aur tairti hai; yeh insulator (hiddat-rok) ka kaam karti hai aur neeche ke paani se heat nikalne nahi deti.

book_ref.quote: It acts as an insulator and does not allow heat to escape from the water beneath it

blocks.prompt:
49 In Table 4.2, the property whose bonding change is 'covalent bond breaks' and which determines acidity and alkalinity of the medium is:
(Table 4.2 mein woh property jis mein 'covalent bond toot-ta hai' aur jo medium ki acidity aur alkalinity tay karti hai:)
blocks.explanation: Table 4.2: ionization, covalent bond toot-ta hai, medium ki acidity aur alkalinity tay karti hai.

book_ref.quote: Determine the acidity and alkalinity of medium

blocks.prompt:
50 According to Table 4.2, which property of water moderates Earth's temperature?
(Table 4.2 ke mutabiq paani ki kaun si property zameen ka temperature mo'tadil rakhti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 4.2: zyada heat of vaporization (hydrogen bonding) zameen ka temperature mo'tadil rakhti hai.

book_ref.quote: Moderates Earth’s temperature

blocks.prompt:
51 Carbohydrates formed in photosynthesis contain carbon, hydrogen and oxygen in the molar ratio:
(Photosynthesis mein banne wale carbohydrates mein carbon, hydrogen aur oxygen kis molar ratio mein hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Photosynthesis mein CO₂ ki reduction se bana carbohydrate C, H aur O ko 1:2:1 ki nisbat mein rakhta hai (4.5).

book_ref.quote: contains carbon, hydrogen and oxygen in the molar ratio of 1:2:1

blocks.prompt:
52 Carbohydrates are synthesized as the primary products of:
(Carbohydrates kis amal ki bunyaadi paidawar ke taur par bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Carbohydrates photosynthesis (zia talifi amal) ki bunyaadi paidawar hain (4.5).

book_ref.quote: Carbohydrates are synthesized as the primary products of photosynthesis

blocks.prompt:
53 Monosaccharides may have how many carbon atoms?
(Monosaccharides mein kitne carbon atoms ho sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Monosaccharides saada sugars hain jin mein 3 se 7 carbon atoms hote hain.

book_ref.quote: They may have 3 – 7 carbon atoms

blocks.prompt:
54 Glucose, the primary energy-storage molecule, has how many energy-storing C-H bonds?
(Glucose, jo bunyaadi energy-store molecule hai, mein energy rakhne wale kitne C-H bonds hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bunyaadi energy-store molecule glucose hai jis mein saat energy rakhne wale C-H bonds hain; formula C₆H₁₂O₆.

book_ref.quote: The primary energy-storage molecule is glucose with seven energy-storing CH bonds

blocks.prompt:
55 Glyceraldehyde and dihydroxyacetone belong to which group of monosaccharides?
(Glyceraldehyde aur dihydroxyacetone monosaccharides ke kis group se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Table 4.3: trioses (3 C, C₃H₆O₃) mein glyceraldehyde aur dihydroxyacetone shamil hain.

book_ref.quote: Glyceraldehyde, Dihydroxyacetone

blocks.prompt:
56 The formula of deoxyribose is:
(Deoxyribose ka formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 4.3: pentoses C₅H₁₀O₅ hain (ribose, ribulose), magar deoxyribose C₅H₁₀O₄ hai.

book_ref.quote: Ribose, Deoxyribose (C₅H₁₀O₄), Ribulose

blocks.prompt:
57 Which group of monosaccharides (C₇H₁₄O₇) is rare in nature and occurs as an intermediate in photosynthesis?
(Monosaccharides ka kaun sa group (C₇H₁₄O₇) qudrat mein kam paya jata hai aur photosynthesis mein darmiyani maadda hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 4.3: heptoses (7 C, C₇H₁₄O₇) qudrat mein kam hain (photosynthesis mein darmiyani maadda).

book_ref.quote: Rare in nature (intermediate in photosynthesis)

blocks.prompt:
58 Glucose and fructose are structural isomers because in fructose the double-bonded oxygen is attached to:
(Glucose aur fructose structural isomers hain kyun ke fructose mein double-bonded oxygen kahan jura hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fructose mein double-bonded oxygen andar wale carbon no. 2 par hai, aakhri carbon par nahi; is liye glucose aur fructose structural isomers hain.

book_ref.quote: In fructose, the double-bonded oxygen is attached to an internal carbon (no. 2)

blocks.prompt:
59 Glucose and galactose are stereoisomers. They differ in the orientation of the OH group at carbon number:
(Glucose aur galactose stereoisomers hain. In mein kis carbon number par OH group ka rukh mukhtalif hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glucose aur galactose mein carbon no. 4 par aik OH group ka rukh mukhtalif hai, is liye yeh stereoisomers hain.

book_ref.quote: Glucose and galactose have a difference in the orientation of one hydroxyl (OH) group at carbon no. 4

blocks.prompt:
60 Which pentose sugar occurs as a precursor in photosynthesis?
(Kaun si pentose sugar photosynthesis mein precursor (pehla maadda) hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ribose aur deoxyribose nucleic acids aur ATP mein hain; ribulose photosynthesis mein precursor hai.

book_ref.quote: ribulose (which occurs as a precursor in photosynthesis)

blocks.prompt:
61 In the ring form of glucose, the oxygen-bridge develops between carbon numbers:
(Glucose ki ring shakal mein oxygen-bridge kin carbon numbers ke darmiyan banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glucose mein oxygen-bridge C-1 aur C-5 ke darmiyan banta hai aur chhe kono wala pyran ring banta hai.

book_ref.quote: In case of glucose, oxygen-bridge develops between carbon number 1 and 5

blocks.prompt:
62 The ring of fructose is a:
(Fructose ka ring kaisa hota hai?)

options.text: paanch kono wala furan ring (C-2 aur C-5 ke darmiyan bridge)
chhe kono wala pyran ring (C-1 aur C-5)
paanch kono wala furan ring (C-1 aur C-4)
chaar kono wala ring (C-1 aur C-3)

blocks.explanation: Fructose mein oxygen-bridge C-2 aur C-5 ke darmiyan banta hai, is liye paanch kono wala furan ring banta hai.

book_ref.quote: In fructose, oxygen-bridge is formed between carbon number 2 and 5

blocks.prompt:
63 When ribose goes into solution, its oxygen-bridge develops between carbons:
(Ribose jab mehlool (solution) mein jata hai to us ka oxygen-bridge kin carbons ke darmiyan banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ribose mein oxygen-bridge C-1 aur C-4 ke darmiyan banta hai aur paanch kono wala furan ring banta hai.

book_ref.quote: When ribose goes in solution, oxygen-bridge develops between carbon number 1 and 4

blocks.prompt:
64 A polymer formed when many beta-D-glucose molecules join together is:
(Bohat se beta-D-glucose molecules jur kar kaun sa polymer banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Bohat se alpha-D-glucose starch banate hain; bohat se beta-D-glucose cellulose banate hain.

book_ref.quote: When many beta-D-glucose molecules join together, they form a polymer called cellulose

blocks.prompt:
65 In a Fischer projection a sugar is shown:
(Fischer projection mein sugar kis shakal mein dikhayi jati hai?)

options.text: khuli zanjeer (open chain) ki shakal mein

blocks.explanation: Fischer projection (Emil Fischer, 1891) khuli zanjeer (open chain) dikhata hai; Haworth projection ring wali shakal dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: In a Fischer projection the carbohydrate is shown in its open chain form

blocks.prompt:
66 The covalent bond between two monosaccharides in a disaccharide is called:
(Disaccharide mein do monosaccharides ke darmiyan covalent bond kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Disaccharides do monosaccharides se dehydration synthesis se bante hain; in ke darmiyan bond glycosidic bond hai.

book_ref.quote: The covalent bond between two monosaccharides is called glycosidic bond

blocks.prompt:
67 Which disaccharide is found in many cereals and is formed as an intermediate during digestion of starch?
(Kaun sa disaccharide bohat se anaajon mein hai aur starch ke hazme mein darmiyani maadda ban kar banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Maltose (do glucose, 1,4-glycosidic bond) gandum aur makai jaise anaajon mein hai aur starch ke hazme mein banta hai.

book_ref.quote: It is found in many cereals (wheat, corn etc.)

blocks.prompt:
68 Lactose is made of:
(Lactose kin se bana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lactose galactose 1-4 glucose hai; yeh sirf mammals ke doodh mein hai aur bachon ki energy ka bara zariya hai.

book_ref.quote: It is found only in mammalian milk

blocks.prompt:
69 Which disaccharide is called the transport disaccharide because it carries glucose in the phloem of higher plants?
(Kaun sa disaccharide transport disaccharide kehlata hai kyun ke yeh bare paudon ke phloem mein glucose le jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sucrose (glucose 1-2 fructose) bare paudon ke phloem mein transport product hai, is liye transport disaccharide kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: That is why it is also known as transport disaccharide

blocks.prompt:
70 The correct molecular formula of sucrose is:
(Sucrose ka sahi molecular formula kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sucrose = glucose C₆H₁₂O₆ + fructose C₆H₁₂O₆ − H₂O = C₁₂H₂₂O₁₁ (kitaab ki ghalti C₁₁H₂₂O₁₁ durust ki gayi).

book_ref.quote: The molecular formula of sucrose is printed

blocks.prompt:
71 High-fructose corn syrup replaced sucrose in many foods because:
(High-fructose corn syrup ne bohat si ghizaon mein sucrose ki jagah kyun le li?)

options.text: glucose sucrose se do guna meetha hai
fructose sucrose se bhi zyada meetha hai aur syrup sasta hai
beet se sucrose nahi nikal sakta

blocks.explanation: Glucose sucrose se aadha meetha hai, magar fructose (makai ke starch ke glucose se bana) sucrose se zyada meetha hai aur syrup sasta hai.

book_ref.quote: Because glucose is only half as sweet as sucrose

blocks.prompt:
72 The most complex and most abundant carbohydrates in nature are:
(Qudrat mein sab se pecheeda aur sab se zyada paye jane wale carbohydrates kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Polysaccharides bohat se monosaccharides ki lambi zanjeerein hain; yeh sab se pecheeda aur zyada paye jane wale carbohydrates hain.

book_ref.quote: Polysaccharides are the most complex and most abundant carbohydrates found in nature

blocks.prompt:
73 Starch is a good storage polysaccharide in plants because, being insoluble, it:
(Starch paudon mein achha zakheera polysaccharide hai kyun ke hal na hone ki wajah se yeh:)

options.text: water potential nahi badalta, is liye cells osmosis se paani nahi lete

blocks.explanation: Starch hal nahi hota, is liye plant cells ka water potential nahi badalta aur cells osmosis se paani nahi lete.

book_ref.quote: Because it is insoluble, it does not change water potential of plant cells

blocks.prompt:
74 Amylose is a chain of glucose with 1,4-glycosidic linkages that is:
(Amylose 1,4-glycosidic linkages wali glucose ki zanjeer hai jo:)

options.text: seedhi, be-shaakh aur helix mein lipti hui

blocks.explanation: Amylose seedhi aur be-shaakh hai magar helix mein lipat jati hai; amylopectin mein 1,6 shaakhein hain.

book_ref.quote: However, it tends to coil up into a helix

blocks.prompt:
75 The branches of amylopectin are formed by:
(Amylopectin ki shaakhein kis linkage se banti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Amylopectin 1,4 se juri glucose zanjeer hai jis mein 1,6-glycosidic shaakhein hain, is liye amylase ke liye zyada sire hain.

book_ref.quote: It also has branches (with 1,6-glycosidic linkages)

blocks.prompt:
76 Both amylose and amylopectin are broken down by the enzyme amylase into:
(Amylose aur amylopectin dono ko enzyme amylase kis mein tor deta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Amylose aur amylopectin (kitaab ki ghalti 'amylase' durust) dono ko amylase maltose mein torta hai, mukhtalif raftaar se.

book_ref.quote: amylose and amylopectin (the two parts of starch) are both broken down by the enzyme amylase

blocks.prompt:
77 Glycogen can be broken down to glucose very quickly because it is:
(Glycogen bohat jaldi glucose mein kyun toot sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glycogen, janwaron ka zakheera polysaccharide jo zyada tar muscles aur liver mein hai, bohat shaakhdaar hai is liye jaldi toot-ta hai.

book_ref.quote: Because it is so highly branched, it can be broken down to glucose very quickly

blocks.prompt:
78 Glycogen is stored mainly in:
(Glycogen zyada tar kahan jama hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glycogen janwar zakheera polysaccharide ke taur par banate hain aur yeh zyada tar muscles aur liver mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: and is found mainly in muscles and liver

blocks.prompt:
79 Cellulose differs from starch in that cellulose contains:
(Cellulose starch se is tarah mukhtalif hai ke cellulose mein:)

options.text: alpha-glucose, jis mein carbon 1 par OH neeche hai
beta-glucose, jis mein carbon 1 par OH upar hai

blocks.explanation: Starch aur glycogen mein alpha-glucose (C-1 par OH neeche) hai; cellulose mein beta-glucose (C-1 par OH upar) hai, is liye har doosra glucose ulta hai.

book_ref.quote: while cellulose contains beta-glucose, in which OH group on carbon 1 sticks up

blocks.prompt:
80 Cellulose microfibrils are formed when hundreds of cellulose chains are linked by:
(Cellulose microfibrils tab bante hain jab saikron cellulose zanjeerein kis se jurti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Cellulose ki seedhi beta 1-4 zanjeerein hydrogen bonds se jur kar microfibrils banati hain jo mazboot fibrils banate hain.

book_ref.quote: Hundreds of these chains are linked together by hydrogen bonds to form cellulose microfibrils

blocks.prompt:
81 Cellulose that humans cannot digest is referred to as:
(Woh cellulose jo insaan hazam nahi kar sakte, kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Beta-glycosidic bond amylase se nahi toot-ta; insaan cellulose hazam nahi kar sakte aur ise dietary fibre kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: Humans cannot digest cellulose, and it is referred to as dietary fibre

blocks.prompt:
82 Chitin is found in:
(Chitin kahan paya jata hai?)

options.text: kekron aur keeron ke bairooni dhanche aur fungi ki cell wall

blocks.explanation: Chitin, badla hua cellulose, kekron, lobsters aur keeron ke bairooni dhanche aur fungi ki cell wall mein hai.

book_ref.quote: It also makes the cell wall of fungi

blocks.prompt:
83 In chitin, each glucose molecule is modified by the addition of a:
(Chitin mein har glucose molecule mein kya shamil karke use badla gaya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chitin cellulose ki tarah glucose ka polymer hai, magar har glucose mein nitrogen wala group shamil hai.

book_ref.quote: each glucose molecule has been modified by the addition of a nitrogen-containing group

blocks.prompt:
84 Which polysaccharide from the cell walls of red algae is used to grow bacteria and fungi in laboratories?
(Red algae ki cell walls ka kaun sa polysaccharide labs mein bacteria aur fungi ugane ke liye istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar red algae ki cell walls mein hai; yeh ghiza ko gaarha karta hai aur bacteria aur fungi ugane ka medium hai.

book_ref.quote: It is found in the cell walls of red algae

blocks.prompt:
85 Murein is a:
(Murein kya hai?)

options.text: prokaryotes ki cell walls ka sugar-peptide polymer

blocks.explanation: Murein sugar-peptide polymer hai jo prokaryotes ki cell walls mein hota hai.

book_ref.quote: It is a sugar-peptide polymer and is found in the cell walls of prokaryotes

blocks.prompt:
86 The most abundant organic compounds in a cell are:
(Cell mein sab se zyada paye jane wale organic compounds kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Proteins cell mein sab se zyada organic compounds hain, amino acids ke polymers (4.6).

book_ref.quote: The most abundant organic compounds in cell are proteins

blocks.prompt:
87 The term 'protein' was coined by J. J. Berzelius in:
(Lafz 'protein' J. J. Berzelius ne kab banaya?)
blocks.explanation: Berzelius ne 'protein' (Greek Proteios, pehle darje ke molecules) 1838 mein banaya; chhapa hua 1938 ghalat hai.

book_ref.quote: The year is printed 1938; Berzelius coined the term

blocks.prompt:
88 Insulin is made of how many amino acids?
(Insulin kitne amino acids se bana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Proteins mein chand se 3000 tak amino acids hote hain: insulin mein 51 (21 aur 30 ki zanjeerein).

book_ref.quote: Insulin has 51 amino acids

blocks.prompt:
89 In an amino acid, the amino group, carboxyl group, hydrogen and R group are all attached to the:
(Amino acid mein amino group, carboxyl group, hydrogen aur R group sab kis se jure hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Amino acid mein NH₂, COOH, H aur R aik hi carbon, yani alpha carbon se jure hote hain.

book_ref.quote: are attached to the same carbon atom (alpha carbon)

blocks.prompt:
90 About how many types of amino acids have been reported in living organisms?
(Jaandaaron mein taqreeban kitni qisam ke amino acids paye gaye hain?)
blocks.explanation: Jaandaaron mein taqreeban 170 qisam ke amino acids hain; taqreeban 25 proteins bana sakte hain; zyada tar proteins 20 se bante hain.

book_ref.quote: about 170 types of amino acids have been reported to occur in living organisms

blocks.prompt:
91 In alanine the side group (R) is:
(Alanine mein side group (R) kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: R group har amino acid ki pehchaan tay karta hai: glycine mein R = H aur alanine mein R = CH₃.

book_ref.quote: R may be a hydrogen atom as in glycine

blocks.prompt:
92 Amino acids that our bodies can make are called non-essential amino acids. How many are there?
(Jo amino acids hamara jism khud bana sakta hai unhein non-essential kehte hain. Yeh kitne hain?)
blocks.explanation: 20 amino acids mein se jism gyarah banata hai (non-essential); baqi nau essential hain jo ghiza se aate hain.

book_ref.quote: Out of 20 amino acids, our bodies can make eleven amino acids

blocks.prompt:
93 Which of the following is an essential amino acid?
(In mein se kaun sa essential amino acid hai?)
blocks.explanation: Essential amino acids (ghiza se): methionine, valine, tryptophan, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, threonine, phenylalanine, histidine. Glycine, serine aur alanine non-essential hain.

book_ref.quote: These are called essential amino acids and include methionine

blocks.prompt:
94 Which essential amino acid is necessary only for babies?
(Kaun sa essential amino acid sirf bachon ke liye zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nau essential amino acids mein se histidine sirf bachon ke liye zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: histidine (necessary only for babies)

blocks.prompt:
95 A peptide bond forms by dehydration synthesis between:
(Peptide bond dehydration synthesis se kin ke darmiyan banta hai?)

options.text: aik amino acid ka amino group aur doosre ka carboxyl group

blocks.explanation: Aik amino acid ke amino group aur doosre ke carboxyl group mein dehydration synthesis se paani nikalta hai aur N aur C ke darmiyan peptide bond banta hai.

book_ref.quote: dehydration synthesis occurs between the amino group of one and the carboxyl group of second amino acid

blocks.prompt:
96 Glycylalanine is a:
(Glycylalanine kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Glycylalanine glycine aur alanine ke jurne se bana dipeptide hai (Figure 4.25).

book_ref.quote: glycylalanine (a dipeptide) is formed by the linking of glycine and alanine

blocks.prompt:
97 The recommended classification of proteins into fibrous and globular is based on their:
(Proteins ki fibrous aur globular mein tajveez-shuda darja-bandi kis buniyad par hai?)
blocks.explanation: Proteins ko kaam (structural, functional) par bhi baanta ja sakta hai, magar tajveez-shuda darja-bandi structure par hai: fibrous aur globular.

book_ref.quote: The recommended classification of proteins is based on their structure

blocks.prompt:
98 Which characteristic belongs to globular proteins?
(Kaun si khasoosiyat globular proteins ki hai?)

options.text: salt, acid ya base mehlool mein hal aur crystal ban sakte hain
hal na hone wale aur non-crystalline

blocks.explanation: Table 4.4: globular proteins gol, tertiary ya quaternary, functional, crystal ban sakne wale aur salt, acid ya base mehlool mein hal hote hain; fibrous proteins hal nahi hote.

book_ref.quote: Soluble in salt, acid or base solutions and in aqueous alcohol

blocks.prompt:
99 Which of the following is a globular protein?
(In mein se kaun sa globular protein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 4.4: haemoglobin, enzymes, antibodies aur kuch hormones globular hain; keratin, collagen, fibrin, actin aur silk fibrous hain.

book_ref.quote: Haemoglobin – oxygen carrying protein

blocks.prompt:
100 Collagen, a fibrous protein, is found in:
(Collagen, aik fibrous protein, kahan paya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Table 4.4: collagen connective tissues ke matrix mein; fibrin khoon ke lothre mein; keratin nakhun, baal, chonch aur jild mein.

book_ref.quote: Collagen – in matrix of connective tissues

blocks.prompt:
101 The sodium-potassium pump in the cell membrane of neurons is made of:
(Neurons ki cell membrane mein sodium-potassium pump kis se bana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Channel proteins maadde ki aamad-o-raft control karte hain; proteins sodium-potassium pump banate hain jo nerve cell mein Na⁺ aur K⁺ andar bahar karta hai.

book_ref.quote: proteins make sodium–potassium pump in the cell membrane of neurons

blocks.prompt:
102 Enzymes that catalyse the breakdown of proteins are:
(Proteins ko torne mein madad dene wale enzymes kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Enzymes proteins hain jo metabolism tez karte hain: proteases proteins torte hain aur polymerases polymers banate hain.

book_ref.quote: proteases catalyse the breakdown of proteins

blocks.prompt:
103 Antidiuretic hormone, a protein hormone:
(Antidiuretic hormone, aik protein hormone, kya karta hai?)

options.text: gurdon mein paani roknay ko barhata hai
khoon ki glucose control karta hai

blocks.explanation: Protein/peptide hormones: insulin khoon ki glucose control karta hai; antidiuretic hormone gurdon mein paani roknay ko barhata hai.

book_ref.quote: antidiuretic hormone (increases water retention by kidneys)

blocks.prompt:
104 Cytochromes work as:
(Cytochromes kis taur par kaam karte hain?)

options.text: electron transport chain mein electron carriers

blocks.explanation: Kuch globular proteins maadde le jate hain; cytochromes electron transport chain mein electron carriers hain.

book_ref.quote: cytochromes work in electron transport chain as electron carriers

blocks.prompt:
105 Which blood protein maintains the osmotic concentration of blood and its ability to flow?
(Khoon ka kaun sa protein khoon ki osmotic concentration aur behne ki salahiyat qaim rakhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Albumin khoon ki osmotic concentration aur behne ki salahiyat qaim rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: Albumin is a blood protein that maintains osmotic concentration of blood

blocks.prompt:
106 On injury, the blood protein fibrinogen is activated into:
(Zakhm lagne par khoon ka protein fibrinogen kis mein badal jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zakhm par fibrinogen fibrin mein badal jata hai jo resha banata hai aur lothra ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: When an injury occurs, fibrinogen is activated into fibrin

blocks.prompt:
107 Spindle fibres are made of the protein:
(Spindle fibres kis protein se bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sukarne (contraction) proteins se hote hain: muscles mein actin aur myosin; tubulin spindle fibres banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Tubulin protein makes spindle fibres

blocks.prompt:
108 Casein is a milk protein that stores:
(Casein doodh ka protein hai jo kya jama karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ion-binding proteins ions jama karte hain: ferritin cell ke andar iron; casein potassium aur calcium ions.

book_ref.quote: casein is a milk protein that stores potassium and calcium ions

blocks.prompt:
109 Proteins that regulate gene action by preventing the synthesis of RNA are:
(Woh proteins jo RNA ki tayyari rok kar gene ke amal ko control karte hain:)
blocks.explanation: Repressors RNA ki tayyari rok kar gene ka amal control karte hain taake genes zaroorat ke waqt aur jagah kaam karein.

book_ref.quote: Repressors are the proteins that regulate gene action by preventing the synthesis of RNA

blocks.prompt:
110 Blood ferritin levels are measured as a diagnostic tool of:
(Khoon mein ferritin ki miqdaar kis bimari ki tashkhees ke liye naapi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kam ferritin ka matlab iron ki kami ka khatra jo anaemia (khoon ki kami) tak le ja sakta hai; zyada ferritin ka matlab iron ki ziyadti.

book_ref.quote: If ferritin is low there is a risk for lack of iron

blocks.prompt:
111 The primary structure of a protein represents:
(Protein ka primary structure kya zahir karta hai?)

options.text: polypeptide chain mein amino acids ki tadaad aur tarteeb

blocks.explanation: Primary structure seedhi tarteeb hai: polypeptide chain mein amino acids ki tadaad aur tarteeb.

book_ref.quote: It represents the number and sequence of amino acid molecules in a polypeptide chain

blocks.prompt:
112 The smaller alpha chain of insulin has:
(Insulin ki chhoti alpha chain mein kitne amino acids hain?)
blocks.explanation: Insulin ki do chains hain: alpha mein 21 aur beta mein 30 amino acids (Figure 4.27).

book_ref.quote: The smaller alpha chain has 21 amino acids while the longer beta chain is made of 30 amino acids

blocks.prompt:
113 The specific sequence of amino acids in the primary structure of a protein is determined by:
(Protein ke primary structure mein amino acids ki khaas tarteeb kis se tay hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary structure ki khaas tarteeb DNA mein nucleotides ki tarteeb se tay hoti hai; koi tabdeeli ghair-maamooli protein banati hai.

book_ref.quote: This specificity in primary structure is determined by the order of nucleotides in DNA

blocks.prompt:
114 In sickle cell haemoglobin, at position six of each beta chain:
(Sickle cell haemoglobin mein har beta chain ki chhati jagah par kya hota hai?)

options.text: glutamic acid ki jagah valine hota hai
aik amino acid ghayab hota hai

blocks.explanation: Har beta chain ki chhati jagah par sirf aik amino acid ki ghalti: glutamic acid ki jagah valine; red cells darranti numa ho jate hain (sickle cell anaemia).

book_ref.quote: In sickle cell haemoglobin, amino acid valine is present in the place of glutamic acid

blocks.prompt:
115 The human body has over how many proteins, each with its specific primary structure?
(Insaani jism mein kitne se zyada proteins hain jin mein har aik ka apna primary structure hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insaani jism mein 10,000 se zyada proteins hain, har aik mein amino acids ki khaas tadaad, tarteeb aur qisam hai.

book_ref.quote: These are over 10,000 proteins in human body

blocks.prompt:
116 In secondary structure, coiling of a polypeptide chain results in:
(Secondary structure mein polypeptide chain ke lipatne se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lipatne se alpha helix aur tah hone se pleated sheet banti hai; dono amino aur carboxyl groups ke hydrogen bonds se qaim hain.

book_ref.quote: Coiling of a polypeptide chain results in alpha helix while folding makes a pleated sheet

blocks.prompt:
117 The globular tertiary structure of a protein is maintained by:
(Protein ka globular tertiary structure kin bonds se qaim rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tertiary structure pecheeda globular shakal hai jo ionic, hydrogen aur disulphide bonds se qaim hai.

book_ref.quote: The globular shape is maintained by ionic, hydrogen and disulphide bonds

blocks.prompt:
118 In the tertiary structure of a protein, the hydrophobic (non-polar) amino acids are:
(Protein ke tertiary structure mein hydrophobic (non-polar) amino acids kahan hote hain?)

options.text: chain se nikal diye jate hain

blocks.explanation: Hydrophobic amino acids paani ki hydrogen bonding kharab karte hain is liye andar chhupe hote hain; hydrophilic amino acids bahar paani ki taraf hote hain.

book_ref.quote: The hydrophobic (non-polar) amino acids aggregate in such a way

blocks.prompt:
119 The quaternary structure of a protein is formed by:
(Protein ka quaternary structure kaise banta hai?)

options.text: tertiary structure wali do ya zyada polypeptide chains ka ikattha hona
aik chain ka sheet mein tah hona

blocks.explanation: Do ya zyada tertiary chains jo hydrophobic interactions, hydrogen aur ionic bonds se juri hon, quaternary structure banati hain.

book_ref.quote: This aggregation of tertiary structures makes the quaternary structure of protein

blocks.prompt:
120 Lipids are non-polar molecules that are:
(Lipids non-polar molecules hain jo:)

options.text: paani mein hal magar ether mein nahi
paani mein hal nahi hote magar ether jaise organic solvents mein hal hote hain
paani aur ether dono mein hal

blocks.explanation: Lipids non-polar molecules ka group hain jo paani mein hal nahi hote magar organic solvents (ether, alcohol) mein hal hote hain (4.7).

book_ref.quote: insoluble in water but soluble in organic solvents

blocks.prompt:
121 Acylglycerols that are liquid at room temperature are called:
(Woh acylglycerols jo kamre ke temperature par maae (liquid) hon, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Maae acylglycerols oils hain (zyada tar paudon mein, jaise moongphali, makai, castor oil); thos fats hain (zyada tar janwaron mein).

book_ref.quote: The acylglycerols which are liquid at room temperature, are called oils

blocks.prompt:
122 Triacylglycerols, also called neutral lipids, have:
(Triacylglycerols, jinhein neutral lipids bhi kehte hain, mein kya hota hai?)

options.text: aik glycerol dhanche se jure teen fatty acids
do fatty acids aur aik phosphate

blocks.explanation: Triacylglycerols mein teen fatty acids (aik jaise ya mukhtalif) aik glycerol dhanche se jure hote hain.

book_ref.quote: triacylglycerol (triglycerides), also called neutral lipids

blocks.prompt:
123 Glycerol is a:
(Glycerol kya hai?)

options.text: COOH par khatam lambi hydrocarbon zanjeer
3 carbon wala alcohol jis ke har carbon par hydroxyl group hai

blocks.explanation: Glycerol 3 carbon wala alcohol hai; har carbon par hydroxyl group hai aur teeno carbons acylglycerol ka dhancha banate hain.

book_ref.quote: It is a 3C alcohol and each of its carbon bears a hydroxyl group

blocks.prompt:
124 Fatty acids are hydrocarbon chains with carbon atoms in:
(Fatty acids ki hydrocarbon zanjeer mein carbon atoms kitne hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Fatty acids lambi hydrocarbon zanjeerein hain jin mein juft (even) tadaad mein carbon (4-30) hote hain aur aakhir mein carboxyl (-COOH) group.

book_ref.quote: with carbon in even number 4 – 30

blocks.prompt:
125 Unsaturated fatty acids:
(Unsaturated fatty acids:)

options.text: koi double bond nahi aur zyada melting point
andar ke tamam carbons poori tarah hydrogen wale
double bonds, tedhi zanjeer aur kam melting point

blocks.explanation: Unsaturated fatty acids mein double bonds (zyada se zyada 6), kam hydrogen, tedhi zanjeer aur kam melting point hota hai; saturated seedhe aur zyada melting point wale hain.

book_ref.quote: These fatty acids form bent chains, and have a low melting point

blocks.prompt:
126 A fatty acid with more than one double bond is called:
(Aik se zyada double bond wala fatty acid kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik double bond: mono-unsaturated; aik se zyada: poly-unsaturated.

book_ref.quote: If a fatty acid has one double bond it is called mono-unsaturated

blocks.prompt:
127 When an ester (acylglycerol) forms by dehydration synthesis, the water molecule comes from:
(Jab ester (acylglycerol) dehydration synthesis se banta hai to paani ka molecule kahan se aata hai?)

options.text: OH alcohol se aur H acid se
OH acid ke carboxyl group se aur H alcohol ke -OH group se
OH aur H dono glycerol se
OH aur H dono fatty acid se

blocks.explanation: Kitaab ki durusti: OH acid ke -COOH group se aur H alcohol ke -OH group se nikalta hai (Figure 4.33).

book_ref.quote: The book says that in ester formation OH is released from the alcohol and H from the acid

blocks.prompt:
128 Animal fats contain more energy than plant oils because they:
(Janwaron ki charbi mein paudon ke oils se zyada energy kyun hoti hai?)

options.text: saturated fatty acids aur is liye zyada C-H bonds rakhti hai

blocks.explanation: Janwaron ki charbi mein saturated fatty acids aur zyada C-H bonds hain; paudon ke oils mein unsaturated fatty acids aur kam C-H bonds.

book_ref.quote: Animal fats contain more energy than do plant oils

blocks.prompt:
129 Phosphatidic acid is composed of:
(Phosphatidic acid kis se bana hai?)

options.text: aik glycerol aur teen fatty acids
